thread.title: Apple Expected to Unveil new iPhone Models on September 12th

author: Myanmar Business Today
title: Apple Expected to Unveil new iPhone Models on September 12th
text:
Apple Expected to Unveil new iPhone Models on September 12th Author: Myanmar Business Today | 13 iphone.jpg
Apple Inc (AAPL.O) said on Thursday it will host an event on Sept. 12 at the Steve Jobs Theater in the company’s Cupertino, California, campus, where it is widely expected to unveil new iPhone models.
Analysts believe Apple plans to release three new smartphones this year, including one with a larger display than previous models. Analysts also expect Apple to release an iPhone with a edge-to-edge display similar to the iPhone X but using less-costly LCD screen technology.
Apple’s event invitation made heavy use of the color gold, fueling speculation on social media that the company plans to launch a gold-colored successor to the iPhone X, which was made available only in silver and gray last year.
Documents filed at the U.S. Federal Communications Commission unsealed earlier this year showed Apple had sought approval for a gold version of its iPhone X, but it never released the color.
A few hours after Apple’s announcement, 9to5Mac, a technology news website, posted photographs of two gold iPhone models stacked on top each other, with a larger-screened model on the bottom. Both models resemble the current iPhone X.
The site said the new flagship model will be called the iPhone XS and that Apple also plans to release a new version of the Apple Watch with a larger display by reducing the edges around it.
9to5Mac told Reuters the photographs were not mockups and represented Apple’s actual planned products but declined to say how it had obtained them. Apple did not respond to requests for comment about the authenticity of the photos.
Apple shares were up 2.2 percent at an all-time high of $227.97.
Apple has for years released its new phone models in the second week of September, and often updates other product lines such as the Apple Watch at the event. The company has already given base-model iPads and some MacBook laptops an update this year.
Apple typically starts selling new iPhones a few weeks after launching them, in time for the holiday shopping season. The iPhone X, priced at $999 and up, has helped Apple beat Wall Street sales expectations.
Investor Warren Buffett, speaking on Thursday to CNBC, said the iPhone is “enormously underpriced” even when it costs $1,000, given how indispensable it has become for so many people. Reuters Myanmar Summary:
Apple Inc (AAPLK.O) သည္ ကယ္လီ ဖိုးနီးယားရွိ Cupertino တြင္ရွိေသာ Steve Jobs Theater
တြင္ လာမည့္ စက္တင္ဘာ လ ၁၂ ရက္ေန႔တြင္ အခမ္းအနားတစ္ခုျပဳလုပ္သြားမည္ျဖစ္ေၾကာင္း ေၾကညာခဲ့သည္။
အဆိုပါအခမ္းအနားတြင္ iPhone ေမာ္ ဒယ္လ္အသစ္မ်ား ထုတ္ျပသြားဖြယ္ရွိ ေၾကာင္း ခန္႔မွန္းထားၾကသည္။
ေလ့လာသံုးသပ္သူမ်ားကေတာ့ Apple သည္ ယခင္ေမာ္ဒယ္မ်ားထက္ မ်က္ႏွာျပင္ ပိုႀကီးေသာ စမတ္ဖုန္းသံုးလံုး ထုတ္လုပ္ဖြယ္ ရွိေနေၾကာင္း ယူဆထားၾကသည္။ အသစ္ ထုတ္မည့္ iPhoneသည္ iPhoneX
ကဲ့သုိ႔ပင္ မ်က္ႏွာျပင္ျပည့္ စခရင္ျဖင့္ ထုတ္လုပ္ဖြယ္ ရွိၿပီး ကုန္က်စရိတ္နည္းပါးေသာ LCD ရင္နည္းပညာကို အသံုးျပဳသြားဖြယ္ရွိသည္ဟု လည္း ယူဆထားၾကသည္။
Apple ၏ ဖိတ္စာမွာ ေရႊေရာင္ျဖင့္ျပဳလုပ္ ထားရာ အသစ္ထုတ္မည့္ iPhone X
၏ ေနာက္မ်ိဳးဆက္သည္ iPhone X ထုတ္စဥ္ က မပါခဲ့ေသာ ေရႊေရာင္ျဖင့္ ထြက္ရွိလာ ဖြယ္ရွိသည္ဟု ထင္ေၾကးေပးေနၾကသည္။ iPhone X မွာ ေငြေရာင္၊ မီးခိုးေရာင္ျဖင့္သာ ထြက္ရွိခဲ့သည္။
U.S. Federal Communications Commission က ယခုႏွစ္အေစာပိုင္းတြင္ ထုတ္ျပန္ခဲ့သည့္ စာရြက္စာတမ္းမ်ားတြင္ ေတာ့ Apple သည္ iPhoneX ကို ေရႊေရာင္ ျဖင့္ ထုတ္လုပ္ခြင့္ျပဳရန္ ေလွ်ာက္ထားမႈရွိခဲ့ ေသာ္လည္း ေရႊေရာင္ျဖင့္ ထုတ္လုပ္ခဲ့ျခင္း မရွိေပ။
Apple ၏ ေၾကညာခ်က္ထြက္ရွိၿပီးမၾကာ မီတြင္ နည္းပညာသတင္း ဝက္ဘ္ဆုိဒ္ တစ္ခု ျဖစ္ေသာ 9to5Mac
သည္ ေရႊေရာင္ iPhone ေမာ္ဒယ္ႏွစ္ခု၏ ဓာတ္ပံုမ်ားကို အင္တာနက္ ေပၚတင္ခဲ့ၿပီး ေမာ္ဒယ္ႏွစ္မ်ိဳးလံုးမွာ လက္ရွိ iPhone
ႏွင့္ ဆင္တူေနသည္။
အဆိုပါ ဓာတ္ပံုမ်ားမွာ လုပ္ႀကံဖန္တီးထား ေသာ ဓာတ္ပံုမ်ားမဟုတ္ဘဲ Apple
က အ သစ္ထုတ္မည့္ဖုန္းမ်ားျဖစ္ေၾကာင္း အတည္ ျပဳခဲ့ေသာ္လည္း ယင္းဓာတ္ပံုမ်ားကို မည္သုိ႔ မည္ပံုရရွိခဲ့သည္ကိုမူ ေျပာၾကားရန္ ျငင္းဆန္ ခဲ့သည္။
Appleကေတာ့ တစ္စံုတစ္ရာ မွန္ခ်က္ေပး ခဲ့ျခင္းမရွိေပ။
Apple၏ အစုရွယ္ယာေစ်းမ်ားလည္း အေမရိကန္ေဒၚလာ ၂၂၇ ဒသမ ၉၇ ေဒၚ လာအထိ စံခ်ိန္တင္ျမင့္တက္သြားခဲ့သည္။
Appleသည္ ဖုန္းေမာ္ဒယ္ အသစ္မ်ား ကို စက္တင္ဘာလ ဒုတိယအပတ္တြင္ ထုတ္ ျပေလ့ရွိၿပီး ထိုအခမ္းအနားတြင္ Apple Watch ကဲ့သို႔ေသာ ထုတ္ကုန္မ်ားကို အဆင့္ ျမႇင့္တင္မႈ လုပ္ထားသည္ျခင္းမ်ား ကို ထုတ္ျပေလ့ရွိသည္။
Appleသည္ iPhoneအသစ္မ်ားကို စတင္ ထုတ္ျပၿပီး ရက္သတၱပတ္အနည္းငယ္ အတြင္း ေစ်းဝယ္ရာသီအမီ ေစ်းကြက္ထဲသုိ႔ ေရာင္းခ်ေလ့ရွိသည္။ iPhoneX၏ ေစ်း သည္ အေမရိကန္ေဒၚလာ ၉၉၉ ေဒၚလာ ရွိၿပီး Wall Streeet
အေရာင္းခန္႔မွန္းခ်က္ မ်ားကို ေက်ာ္လြန္သြားခဲ့သည္။
